info.name: Plerion API Documentation Alerts AWS integration API

items.docs: Use the API to get the external ID of the tenant. The external ID is fixed for a tenant and used for cross-account access to AWS role. Read more about External Id purpose. ```bash curl "https://au.api.plerion.com/v1/tenant/external-id" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PLERION_API_KEY" ```

Use the API to generate a temporary token required for creating AWS integration using CloudFormation template provided by Plerion.
```bash
  curl -X POST https://au.api.plerion.com/v1/tenant/integrations/token -H "Authorization: Bearer $PLERION_API_KEY"
```

params.name: type
params.description: The type of integration for which the CloudFormation template is required

items.docs:
Use the API to get the CloudFormation template required for creating / updating AWS integrations in Plerion. 
```bash
  curl https://au.api.plerion.com/v1/tenant/cloudformation-templates?type=AWSAccount -H "Authorization: Bearer $PLERION_API_KEY"
```
